codeReview.summary: The implementation successfully builds the A2A client with proper methods (discover, sendTask, getTask, cancelTask, sendSubscribe) and addresses test timeouts by rewriting SSE streaming tests to avoid supertest. All edge cases specified in the feature description are handled properly.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker spent significant time diagnosing test timeouts because `supertest` hangs when used with Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming endpoints. Worker had to rewrite tests to use raw Node.js `http` client. This testing quirk is not documented.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript shows worker discovering 'The tests are getting stuck on SSE streaming tests because the connection isn't being properly closed... supertest doesn't work well with SSE streaming'.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker discovered that Node.js on Windows throws `AggregateError` for network failures instead of specific network error types, requiring updates to test assertion regexes. This cross-platform quirk is not documented.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript shows worker noting 'the network error test expects specific error types but Windows returns AggregateError'.

summary: Passed. The A2A client and server tests are fully implemented and passing. The worker correctly recognized that supertest fails on SSE endpoints and rewrote the tests using the built-in HTTP module, while also handling a Windows-specific AggregateError quirk.
